name: orin-router-service
description: Orin Router: canonical inference gateway over the four Orin free model aliases, free-models-only, with per-account BYOK upstream.

scripts.platform:build: npm --prefix vendor/orin-platform ci && npm --prefix vendor/orin-platform run build
scripts.test:security: npm run platform:build && node --test --import ./test/_hooks.mjs test/auth.test.mjs test/validation.test.mjs test/url-guard.test.mjs test/free-models-and-byok.test.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:contract && npm run test:security && npm run test:sql && npm run test:preview
